sources.title: Faraid al-Usul (Rasa'il), vol. 2
sources.author: Murtada al-Ansari
sources.extraction_method: SQLite page_contents.properties JSON field 'Content'; record_id = page_contents.id; database_page = page_contents.page_number

database_schema: pages(id, number, label, attachment_page_label); page_contents(id, page_number, properties, weight, language_id, page_id, parent_id)
normalization: strip harakat U+064B–U+0652 and tatweel U+0640; collapse whitespace. RAW match is always preferred and reported first.
note: raw zstd files live in book-for-muse; local .bin files are their decompressed copies (hash of decompressed recorded; raw_file_sha256 available from the repo objects).
